title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
summary: Louisa, a cheerful, out-of-work young woman, takes a job caring for Will, a once-adventurous man left paralysed after an accident. He is bitter and withdrawn, and she gradually sees what he has planned.
readIf: you want a funny, warm romance that is meant to make you cry.
skipIf: you want a happy ending, or an assisted-death storyline may upset you.

pairings.reason: Another romance where illness shapes the love story, with a younger voice.
Another warm, funny book about a grumpy man who is drawn back toward life by someone unexpected.
A popular romance that also takes on a hard subject with a heroine making painful choices.
